title: Borrowed Voice
description: Intercept an editor’s scheduled confession and its delivery receipt.
objective: Intercept transfer receipt at Authoritative record / Intercept transfer receipt at Live mirror
condition: All required objectives must be secured. Optional archives pay extra. Quiet bonus uses peak trace.
aftermath: MOTH is a shared identity. One of its authors died before your first contract.

lore.title: Borrowed Voice / Unsent message
lore.text: RHEA / public archivist: Intercept an editor’s scheduled confession and its delivery receipt. The sender asks you to keep the names attached to the evidence; anonymous totals have concealed people before.

lore.title: Borrowed Voice / Custody note
lore.text: Archive custody, Borrowed Voice: MOTH is a shared identity. One of its authors died before your first contract. A second copy carries a hand-written objection to the official disposition.

lore.title: Borrowed Voice / Private annotation
lore.text: Personal note filed under borrowed-voice: MOTH is a shared identity. One of its authors died before your first contract. Someone has crossed out the word inevitable. No replacement was supplied.

revelation: MOTH is a shared identity. One of its authors died before your first contract.
